patch_list: Presses the Daily Streak Check-in button for you when the app is open, once a day. It runs the app's own check-in, so it needs you to be signed in and to open the app each day.
Stops banner and full-screen ads from loading. Rewarded video ads are left alone, so the watch-an-ad-for-points option keeps working.
